Chiguana lies in the Bolivian part of the Altiplano. The salt flat reveals a dry high-altitude landscape, where open ground and distant mountains create sweeping views. It is visited on routes through the country's southwest, along with lagoons and volcanic areas.

The appeal here lies in the surface of the salt flat and its setting among the mountains. Chiguana offers a different part of the high-altitude landscape to explore alongside Uyuni. During the journey, travelers can observe the transition from open salt flats to rocky slopes and see how varied the landscapes of the Altiplano can be.

Chiclayo is a city in Peru, located 13 kilometers from the Pacific coast. It was founded in 1720 by Franciscan monks.

Chiclayo was granted city status in 1835 by Peruvian president Felipe Santiago Salaverry. The president also awarded it the title of Heroic City in recognition of the courage shown by its inhabitants during Peru's War of Independence.

## Visiting Chiclayo

### Chiclayo, a commercial center of Peru!

Today, Chiclayo is one of Peru's largest cities, ranking fourth in population after Lima, Trujillo and Arequipa. It is a modern city without the colonial buildings typically associated with Peru. Chiclayo is surrounded by sugarcane and rice plantations in a fertile valley. Its residents include descendants of the Mochica and Chimú peoples. Situated at a crossroads, the city has a thriving commercial life and is a good place for shopping.
